items.title: aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws
items.summary: The aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws offered by Amazon Web Services includes official tools, plugins, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that enable AI agents to develop, deploy, and manage applications on AWS. This Python-based toolkit allows AI agents to work more compatibly with AWS infrastructure in software development processes.

snapshot.description: Official, AWS-supported MCP servers, skills, and plugins to help AI agents build on AWS. Help AI coding agents build, deploy, and manage applications on AWS.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.summary: Nutlope/hallmark offers a design skill that prevents content created on AI-powered code editors like Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex from looking like it was generated by AI. This tool aims to visually individualize standard AI outputs that emerge during software development processes.

snapshot.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.summary: pbakaus/impeccable offers a design language and guidance system that AI coding agents can use when designing interfaces. Developed in Rust, this tool aims to improve frontend designs generated by AI through 24 commands and 62 deterministic detector rules.

snapshot.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design. Design guidance for AI coding agents. 1 skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration, and 62 deterministic detector rules for AI-generated frontend design.

items.title: pollen-robotics/microduck
items.summary: microduck, developed by Pollen Robotics, is a 25-centimeter bipedal duck robot project powered by a Rockchip RK3566 processor. The software, written in Rust, manages fifteen servos via neural policies to execute the robot's movement and control processes.

snapshot.description: A Tiny biped duck robot 🦆. This repo is the duck's brain. About 25 cm and 800 g of robot, run by a handful of daemons on a Rockchip RK3566: a 50 Hz control loop driving fifteen servos from neural policies, the radios and the camera, and the update machinery that gets new software onto a robot without bricking it.

items.title: google-gemini/gemini-cli
items.summary: gemini-cli, developed by Google, is an open-source (source code accessible to everyone) tool that provides direct access to the Gemini AI model via the terminal. The software allows users to create AI prompts quickly and lightweight in a command-line environment.

snapshot.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal. Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal. It provides lightweight access to Gemini, giving you the most direct path from your prompt to our model.

items.title: makecindy/cindy
items.summary: Cindy is an open-source (source code open for access and development) AI agent designed to complete real work in your projects and applications, working right out of the box. It combines multiple models and tools into a single structure, allowing users to manage their workflows.

snapshot.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。. Cindy is an open-source AI agent that works out of the box. She brings multiple harnesses, models and tools into one agent that finishes real work in your projects and apps. Ready from day one, yours to shape over time.

items.title: Show HN: Steal My Bitcoin
items.summary: Steal My Bitcoin is a platform created to test how a recently discovered PHP remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability can be exploited in the real world. The developer invites users to access the system to observe the concrete effects of this security vulnerability.

snapshot.description: Made this because I'm curious if anyone out there has figured out how to actually use this PHP RCE we spent the last few days panicking over. Have fun!

items.title: The Goose Programming Language
items.summary: The Goose is a new programming language designed for low-level system programming languages. It aims to develop system software with a structure focused on memory safety and performance.

items.title: Node2Shell evolves to HTTP2Shell, blast radius affects many HTTP libs and apps
items.summary: The evolution of the Node2Shell vulnerability into HTTP2Shell puts numerous HTTP libraries and applications that use the Brotli data compression algorithm at risk. To avoid being affected by this vulnerability, coded as CVE-2026-111497, it is necessary to check the versions used and perform updates.

snapshot.description: The Brotli flaw behind Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) affects many libraries and applications using HTTP with Brotli or brotlicffi installed. Check your versions and upgrade to the fix.

items.title: I don't understand quantum physics (2018)
items.summary: This resource, prepared by the University of Southampton, covers the fundamental concepts of quantum physics and the difficult-to-understand points in this field. Focusing on the complexity of physical phenomena, the study explains the principles of quantum physics within an academic framework.

items.title: XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B
items.summary: Spark-X2.6-4B, published on the Hugging Face platform, is an artificial intelligence model focused on text generation. Using the same architecture as its previous version, the model offers performance improvements in areas such as coding, reasoning, and multilingual content processing thanks to post-training improvements.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Spark-X2.6-4B retains exactly the same architecture as Spark-X2.5-4B, achieving its capability gains through improved post-training. It delivers substantial improvements in coding, agent, long-context, multilingual, reasoning, etc. These advances enable more capable and practical on-device AI for developers and users tackling real-world tasks.
